newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Jan. 20:
WASHINGTON - Teamster delivery drivers approved a new contract with Giant Food Inc., ending a five-week strike against the Washington area's largest supermarket chain.
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton aims to shape America as it enters the 21st century.
WASHINGTON - Weeks of work to plan President Bill Clinton's second inauguration will culminate with his swearing in as the last president of the 20th century at noon Monday.
WASHINGTON - The presidential inauguration is a time when Washington shows itself off, but those who live here see a city with all the frailties of urban America.
HEBRON - Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat took possession of the last Israeli-occupied city of the West Bank, Hebron, speaking of reconciliation and peace.

WASHINGTON - The man accused of being the Unabomber who carried out a 17-year bombing spree which killed three people and injured 23, wrote many letters to his family which revealed his tormented psyche.
